question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids at Water Plants Intake (*7), does the permit require weekly monitoring and reporting of flow-weighted-average intake concentrations (reported as the geometric mean of weekly values at the drinking water treatment plant intake(s)) without imposing enforceable numeric limits on the intake measurements themselves, with those reported values serving as the influent component in the Net Total Dissolved Solids Increase calculation under footnote *8?
required_context: Footnote *7 (intake TDS measurement location, flow-weighted-average method, and geometric-mean reporting)
Footnote *8 (net increase calculated from Outfall 001 discharge minus flow-weighted-average influent)
Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase (*8) limit rows on page 5
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page 4, Section part_i, Water Plants Intake (*7) row and footnote *7
notes: The nominated row shows Report-only limit entries alongside a 1/Week monitoring frequency and a footnote-defined measurement methodology at an intake location rather than an outfall. Resolving how these elements combine affects whether intake TDS is subject to numeric limit comparison, what monitoring was required, and how absent intake results should be classified relative to net-increase derivations.
